What it is

Your body keeps the score of everything it carries: stress, strain, old injury. Amari Method is hands-on work that helps it settle and reorganize. Garrett Hewstan developed 8 core protocols over 25 years. You learn them in session and practice them at home.

How it works
1

We find where your body is out of balance.

2

You learn the protocols: gentle, simple, yours to keep.

3

You practice them at home, between visits.

Most people feel a difference in their first session.
